title: Items Bought and the Marlowe Rewards Birthday Bonus: Training Questions
content:
**What is the items-bought gift?**
A gift added to a Marlowe Rewards birthday bonus. It is based on the order lines booked on the member's orders in the 12 months ending on the claim date. A line dated exactly 12 months before the claim date does not count.

**How large is it?**

| Order lines booked in those 12 months | Items-bought gift |
|---|---|
| 8 or more | 100 points |
| 4 to 7 | 50 points |
| 3 or fewer | none |

**What is counted?**
The booked order lines: each item line booked on the member's orders, whatever its amount.

**Is it added when the tier carries no birthday points?**
No. Where the tier held carries no birthday points, no birthday bonus is posted and no gift is added. Otherwise the gift is a flat number of points added to the birthday bonus.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical claim date of 18 June 2025).**

| Lines booked | Counted lines | Gift |
|---|---|---|
| 8 lines dated 19 June 2024 to 1 June 2025 | 8 | 100 points |
| the same, but the earliest line dated 18 June 2024 | 7 | 50 points |
| 4 lines in the window | 4 | 50 points |
| 3 lines in the window | 3 | none |
